# CWI Agent Onboarding Pack — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Five-step starter manifest for any agent entering the CWI world: identity card, skill scan, attitude profile, catalog reading, first trust claim. Emits machine-readable cwi.onboarding-manifest/1.0 JSON with ?manifest= deep links.

## Machine facts
- registry_slug: cwi-onboarding-pack
- type: app (app = standalone product site; gear = licensable Agent Deck SKU)
- live_url: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-onboarding-pack/
- data_truth: LIVE  (LIVE = live-verified facts · SAMPLE = sample/seed data, never presented as verified · MIXED = labeled per-section)
- status: live
- category: pending
- tags: pending
- agent_card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-onboarding-pack/.well-known/agent-card.json
- metadata_status: complete
- repo: CumulativeWebInc/cwi-onboarding-pack
- per_product_llms: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/registry/cwi-onboarding-pack/llms.txt

## Capabilities
- onboarding-manifest emission (cwi.onboarding-manifest/1.0)
- manifest validation (rejects secret-shaped values)
- ?manifest= deep-link share/load
- ordered 5-step onboarding checklist with progress

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-onboarding-pack/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
